assessment: The study presents a landmark finding on quantifying the orientation and organization of chondrocyte columns in the prenatal and postnatal growth plate cartilage using advanced 3D imaging and a sophisticated image analysis pipeline. The evidence supporting the authors' conclusions regarding clusters of chondrocytes (instead of columns) in the fetal growth plate is considered compelling, with rigorous imaging analyses. The work will be of broad interest to developmental and cell biologists.
